## Clearer receipts and faster checkout

Karbar 1.3 improves receipt rendering and adds helpful details to checkout and sales history.

### What's new

- Improved receipt layouts and Bengali text rendering, including embedded Bengali fonts.
- Show staff names on sales and receipts, including receipt previews.
- Display product photos in the scanner cart when available.
- Improve navigation from sales history.
- Update Android build tooling and refresh the app screenshot.

### Install

Download the Android APK attached to the release when available. It can be installed over an existing Karbar installation signed with the same key.
